result.reason: The added ownership clause reaches the playbook position: the Company owns the deliverables, work product, Company-furnished materials and Company Data; HDI expressly assigns relevant rights; HDI retains its pre-existing IP; and the Company receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded or necessary HDI IP, including modification and sublicensing rights. It also expressly excludes joint ownership and leaves unrelated operational, approval and trademark provisions unchanged. Drafting is professional, although including unspecified “improvements” within HDI Pre-Existing IP creates minor ambiguity as to whether post-contract, customer-specific improvements could be excluded from Company ownership.
